organization_and_why.name: Habibi Care
organization_and_why.why: domestic cold storage, takes up to 1 pallet, collects within 3h
organization_and_why.profile_excerpt: Emergency shelter providing three meals a day to residents. Two household fridges. Dry storage is a converted closet. No dedicated vehicle. Delivery is far easier for us than pickup. Prepared and ready-to-eat food.

whose_neighborhood.tract: Nearest census tract: 13% of residents below the poverty line, 5% of households without a vehicle, 12% on food or cash assistance (ACS; recipient location is ZIP-level, so this is the area, not the exact block).

outreach_message:
Hello Habibi Care team,

A grocer in Chicago has ten crates of spinach. It is still good but has to move soon. From what we have on file you have the storage for it. The food needs to leave by about 6 hours from now, which leaves you roughly 3 hours of slack to collect. We can arrange a driver, since it has to stay cold on the way.

Can you take it? If you can, tell us the time you can collect and a phone number for pickup. If not, a quick no helps us move to the next place.

Thank you,
[Coordinator name]
